title: Committee of Supply ‒ Head R (Ministry of Law)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply ‒ Head R (Ministry of Law)

sections.label: SIAC arbitration case growth
sections.summary: SIAC case filings grew over 300% in a decade, with 271 cases and $6.23 billion in dispute in 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Over the last decade, the number of cases filed at SIAC grew by more than 300%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: The latest statistics available is that of 2015, registering a record number of 271 cases filed in total.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: This comes up to a total of $6.23 billion in dispute, a 24% increase from 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: In 2015, Singapore was ranked as the No 1 seat of International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) arbitration in Asia, and the fourth most preferred seat of arbitration in the world.

sections.label: Law school and legal framework changes
sections.summary: UniSIM School of Law was launched, and laws were amended for third-party funding and commercial mediation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Amongst others, we launched the SIM University (UniSIM) School of Law to train lawyers in family and criminal law.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: We amended our laws to allow for third-party funding framework in the realm of international arbitration and enacted the Mediation Act to improve the framework for commercial mediation.

sections.label: Probate grant delays and caseload
sections.summary: Obtaining a probate grant takes months, and Family Justice Court probate caseload rose about 26% from 2011 to 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Even when the grant is not contentious and straightforward, the process of making the application and finally obtaining the grant takes months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: I also note that the caseload for probate matters in the Family Justice Court has increased over the years, by about 26%, between 2011 and 2015.

sections.label: Legal industry needs and Tech Start
sections.summary: A six-month Legal Industry Needs Study was carried out, and the Tech Start for Law Programme was jointly announced.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: I believe there was a six-month Legal Industry Needs Study carried out to identify the technology and capability needs of these practices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: I note the Tech Start for Law Programme jointly announced by MinLaw, the Law Society and the Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board (SPRING) Singapore.

sections.label: In-house counsel competency framework
sections.summary: SCCA developed a Competency Framework for three seniorities of in-house counsel across legal, business and conduct competencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: To that end, SCCA has, in consultation with relevant stakeholders, developed a Competency Framework for three different seniorities of in-house counsel across three categories of competencies: legal, business and conduct.

sections.label: Support for SCCA competency framework
sections.summary: SCCA's Competency Framework will be supported as a national standard, but the Government should make it mandatory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: As SCCA is our National Trades Union Congress' U-Associate partner, we have studied this initiative and believe it to be useful for the reasons above.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Hence, we will support and partner SCCA in the launch of this Competency Framework as a national standard for the in-house industry this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: However, if the Government is serious about developing the talent pool for in-house legal counsel in Singapore, then the Competency Framework needs to be mandatory at some point of time.

sections.label: Small Claims Tribunal limit raised
sections.summary: The jurisdictional limit of the Small Claims Tribunal is proposed to be raised to $20,000, and to $30,000 with both parties' consent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: In this regard, I propose to raise the jurisdictional limit of SCT to clear claims of up to $20,000 and up to $30,000 with the consent of both parties to the SCT claim.

sections.label: Rule of law rankings
sections.summary: Singapore is ranked number one in Asia by the World Justice Project's Rule of Law Index 2016 and the Asian Intelligence Report's Corruption Perception Index 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: In terms of commitment to the rule of law, we are number one in Asia, as ranked by the World Justice Project's Rule of Law Index 2016 and the Asian Intelligence Report's Corruption Perception Index 2017.

sections.label: Hague Convention, Mediation Act, third-party funding
sections.summary: Singapore ratified the Hague Convention on Choice of Court Agreements, enacted a Mediation Act, and introduced a third-party funding framework for international commercial arbitration.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Over the past year, we have further strengthened our position.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We have ratified the Hague Convention on Choice of Court Agreements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: This enhances the enforceability of Singapore Court judgments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We have enacted a new Mediation Act to strengthen the enforceability of mediated settlements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: And we have introduced a third-party funding framework to give businesses additional financing options for international commercial arbitration.

sections.label: Legal technology ecosystem and regulation review
sections.summary: The Ministry is working with the Academy of Law, Law Society, Courts and economic agencies to develop a legal technology ecosystem, study online dispute resolution, and review regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Other than legal technology adoption, my Ministry is also working with the Academy of Law, the Law Society, the Courts and a number of economic agencies on several other aspects relating to technology.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: For example, we want to develop an ecosystem to accelerate the creation and adoption of legal technology.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We want to study the feasibility of online dispute resolution and setting up such platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: In addition, we will also review our regulations to ensure that the regulations facilitate innovation and the development of legal technology solutions.

sections.label: Working Group on Legal and Accounting Services
sections.summary: The Working Group on Legal and Accounting Services under CFE, co-chaired with Mr Chaly Mah, was set up to identify growth areas and strategies for the legal sector.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Working Group on Legal and Accounting Services under CFE which I co-chaired with Mr Chaly Mah was set up to identify growth areas and develop strategies for the legal sector's growth and development.

sections.label: UniSIM School of Law established
sections.summary: The UniSIM School of Law was established last year to address the projected shortage of family and criminal practitioners in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Last year, we established the UniSIM School of Law to address the projected shortage of family and criminal practitioners in Singapore.

sections.label: MinLaw-UniSIM Study Award for mature students
sections.summary: The MinLaw-UniSIM Study Award was introduced to help mature Singaporean students not eligible for MOE's tuition grant defray part of their tuition fees.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: To help these mature Singaporean students who are not eligible for the Ministry of Education's (MOE's) tuition grant defray part of the tuition fees, we introduced the MinLaw-UniSIM Study Award.

sections.label: Singapore in-house legal employees study
sections.summary: A study by Aon of Fortune Global 500 employment in corporate functions found Singapore had more in-house legal employees than Hong Kong and Shanghai in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Based on a study of Fortune Global 500 employment in corporate functions by Aon, Singapore has more in-house legal employees than Hong Kong and Shanghai in 2014.

sections.label: Legal aid qualifying criteria updated
sections.summary: In 2013 the qualifying criteria were updated to allow about 25% of Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents to qualify for legal aid, up from 17%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In 2013, the qualifying criteria were updated to allow approximately 25% of Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents to qualify for legal aid, up from 17% previously.

sections.label: CLAS applications and representation increase
sections.summary: CLAS received 2,308 applications in 2016 versus 1,780 in 2014; all 2,308 received basic advice, 1,373 also received full representation or other legal services, a threefold increase over 431 in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: CLAS received 2,308 applications in 2016, compared to 1,780 applications in 2014, before the Government started directly funding CLAS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: All 2,308 accused persons who applied to CLAS in 2016 received basic legal advice, of which 1,373 also received full representation or legal services not involving Court attendance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This is a threefold increase, compared to 2014, where only 431 accused persons received full representation.

sections.label: Funding for two CLAS advocates
sections.summary: From December last year, additional funding was provided to hire two CLAS advocates to strengthen the scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: From December last year, we have provided additional funding to hire two CLAS advocates, to strengthen the scheme.

sections.label: SCT jurisdiction review and POHA update
sections.summary: Increasing the SCT's jurisdiction is under review; as of 31 January 2017, 268 Protection Order applications were filed since POHA took effect on 15 November 2014, with 96 granted, 59 by consent, 77 Expedited Protection Orders granted and 18 Magistrate's Complaints filed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The issue of increasing the SCT's jurisdiction is currently under review by my Ministry and the State Courts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: To update on POHA, as of 31 January 2017, 268 applications for Protection Orders have been filed since it took effect on 15 November 2014.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Out of the 96 Protection Orders granted, 59 were granted by consent.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Seventy-seven Expedited Protection Orders have also been granted, and 18 Magistrate's Complaints have been filed for alleged breach of a Protection Order or Expedited Protection Order.
